acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with a fixture of repeated shell lines; either the stability check matches git's alignment for unchanged spans or the refusal names the alignment it used; test plus one mutation.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1399/1400/1401 lane (PR #922, BASE d47b0f01e). cem-cite refused row `19 script/gate-affected-corvint_test.sh 160:162 test-claim` with cite-span-not-stable although `git diff -U0 d47b0f01e HEAD` shows those base lines unchanged (edits at 154-156 and an insertion after 165); lines 70:110 were accepted. Likely a different diff alignment around repeated if/else/fi lines between the stability check and git diff.
title: cem-cite refuses cite-span-not-stable for an unchanged base span next to duplicate if/else/fi lines
